annotations.text:
A · Quiet column (chosen)
Everything stays on one screen, but labels move into a left rail and choices become segmented controls instead of boxed cards with radio dots, so your eye runs down one edge. The footer reads the task back to you.
Tradeoff: still shows every field at once, so it's the tallest of the three.

B · Sentence
The task reads as a sentence, and each word in a box opens a small picker (the repeat picker is shown open). Extras sit as chips underneath.
Tradeoff: options stay hidden until you tap, and long sentences wrap awkwardly on a phone.

C · Property list
Name up top, then one tidy row per setting showing its current value; tap a row to open it (Repeat is open). Calmest to look at, and it's easy to add settings later.
Tradeoff: changing several things costs a tap per row.
